predecessors.name: British Colonial Empire
predecessors.text: the Province of Canada (split into Ontario and Quebec), Nova Scotia and New Brunswick, British North American colonies

ledger.x: 15 July 1870: Rupert's Land and the North-Western Territory.
1897: the Klondike rush makes the Alaska panhandle a dispute.
20 October 1903: the Alaska boundary is settled.

wars.name: Alaska boundary dispute
wars.outcome: Tribunal award of 20 October 1903 'generally in favour of the United States claim'; Canada got no all-Canadian outlet from the Yukon to the sea.

wars.name: Labrador boundary dispute
wars.outcome: The Judicial Committee of the Privy Council decided in Newfoundland's favour, 'against Canada'; 'Quebec has long rejected the outcome'.

wars.name: Hans Island dispute
wars.outcome: The maritime border of 13 March 1974 'skipped' Hans Island; on 19 December 2023 the border was defined to pass through it.

certainty.note: The inner frontiers of Rupert's Land and the Arctic are nominal and the Alaska panhandle line is disputed; the southern frontier with the United States follows treaty lines and is sharp throughout.
The Alaska line is fixed on 20 October 1903 and the Labrador boundary decided in 1927; the exceptions are the Arctic maritime limits and Hans Island, in dispute until 2023.
